verdict.rationale: Framer documents that every change an external agent makes automatically lands on a branch, where you can review it, undo it, and choose when to merge. Site-wide version history with one-click restore adds rollback. This versions and reviews the outputs of agent-driven automation, not the automation definitions themselves. missing for 10: versioning or review of automation definitions (e.g., Server API publishing workflows or agent instructions), audit or diff detail on agent changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: every change made by an external agent automatically happens on a branch. You can undo changes, review the branch, and decide when to merge it back into your main branch.
Version history and rollback. Every site change is saved automatically, so you can restore any version in seconds.
Branching. Explore ideas in a branch without touching the main project. Merge when it’s ready to ship.
